limits: This inventory maps audit task IDs to exact authored clauses and requirement IDs; it is not a company-native operating record or an audit test.
The 16-provision native overlay is an isolated unreviewed candidate until separate source, route and procedure reviews; all 66 remain unsupported/unrun.
The 46 matter and four context candidates remain outside this source cohort. No outside matter or all-company no-event determination is inferred.

A.authored_test_clause: Compare any proposed obligation from the affected sections to the overlay; block an applicability conclusion based only on the historical XML.

Exercise a regulator request with inaccessible provider records and an urgent access scenario; inspect response authority and preservation without treating ordinary customer disclosure rules as a bar to lawful access.
Check the authority citation in the obligation register without creating a recurring technical control.
Record final-rule effective/compliance dates and exceptions; do not turn the general 180-day floor into an automatic service grace period.
Verify the specific new or modified rule overrides before docketing the compliance date.
Link the authority to the preemption analysis and retain context classification.
Require a provision-by-provision state/federal comparison identifying the applicable test, not a blanket stricter-law assertion.
Record the actual exception and supporting law for each conflict before treating a state duty as displaced.
Inspect the written request and determination; reject a pending request as authority to stop compliance.
Reassess relied-on exceptions on legal/factual change and retain revocation monitoring evidence.
Classify as triggered legal-response context and link the response playbook.
Verify the reserved source entry; retain inventory presence without inventing an operating duty.
Retain correspondence and distinguish assistance from an approval or assurance conclusion.
Keep complaint dates and records, protect reporting and route regulator correspondence; do not convert the complainant clock into the organization's response deadline.
Trigger preservation and authorized cooperation when notified; record review scope and response orders rather than inventing a recurring inspection cadence.
Docket notice receipt, response and service; preserve completed corrective plans and written disposition separately from internal closure.
Check subpoena scope, designated witnesses, service, transcript corrections and counsel-controlled objections against the actual proceeding.
Retain enforcement classification; do not generate a technical control from the penalty authority.
Preserve knowledge, diligence and correction facts for counsel; do not let an incident severity label decide the legal standard.
Analyze actual agency relationships and conduct; a supplier agreement alone does not eliminate exposure.
Resolve the applicable date, tier and current primary adjustment before exposure modeling; leave amounts unpopulated until verified.
Preserve start/end dates and affected occurrences; distinguish continuous failure from incident ticket counts.
Collect supporting facts with provenance and privilege handling rather than auto-scoring mitigation from remediation status.
Preserve discovery and correction evidence and any Secretary extension; internal risk acceptance does not establish an affirmative defense.
Record eligibility analysis, request and actual disposition; do not mark waiver granted when requested.
Counsel verifies occurrence and commencement facts and applicable authority; retention policy is not this limitations determination.
Route proposed terms to authorized counsel and management; retain the actual executed settlement and duties.
Assess additional exposure separately; payment does not automatically resolve every proceeding.
Capture receipt and completeness, docket the hearing path and preserve a statistical study if relied on.
Escalate missed hearing deadlines and preserve final notice; do not presume an appeal remains available.
Reconcile final determination, payment/offset and counsel's available remedies before finance execution.
Prepare accurate authorized communications and track finality; this is not a mandate for routine customer publication by the company.
Activate the case playbook only for a real proceeding; retain source context otherwise.
Verify the proper appellate body and addressee rather than routing to corporate governance.
Test actual/presumed receipt, admitted/denied facts, defense grounds and mailing proof with counsel; do not add the general mail-response extension to this request.
Confirm representative authority and ethical conduct; record exercised or intentionally waived procedural rights.
Maintain orders and assigned actions; distinguish ALJ directions from options or requests and flag contested authority for counsel.
Inspect case communications for prohibited ex parte contact while allowing documented scheduling/status inquiries.
Docket the conference, prepare authorized representatives and reconcile the resulting order to action owners and deadlines.
Verify the settlement counterparty's authority; do not make ALJ signature an invented condition.
Track requests, scoped objections, accessible production and protective/compel motions, including the second 30-day motion window.
Independently compute each exchange deadline and preserve delivery, objections and any extraordinary-circumstance ruling.
Docket motion, opposition, service and quash separately; verify named witnesses, necessary evidence and allowed exceptions.
Reconcile the actual subpoenaing party, service package and authorized fee payment.
Check the actual order first, then filing form, mailing date, opposing counsel service and proof.
Reperform the docket with federal holidays and actual service method; independently test the hearing-request exception.
Reconcile each motion with service and actual ALJ response deadline; oral-motion exceptions require case context.
Escalate missed orders and preserve the actual sanction decision; do not silently cure the docket history.
Link the prior final determination and participation record before asserting issue preclusion.
Organize the evidence burden by issue and preserve breach notification/no-breach support; do not treat no regulator evidence as proof of company compliance.
Retain the study, population and methods for qualified rebuttal; never substitute this enforcement rule for an audit sample-size policy.
Verify witness statements, availability, disclosures and actual ALJ orders before relying on a written statement.
Keep evidence provenance and counsel's privilege/admissibility assessment; confidentiality markings alone do not establish privilege.
Reconcile the official record and request appropriate protection through counsel; do not assume a private internal evidence folder makes the hearing record private.
Docket the actual order and receipt event; preserve timely filed briefs and any allowed reply.
Record service, finality and the separate 30-day appeal path; do not use finality as the appeal deadline.
Maintain appeal, opposition, reconsideration, service and finality events separately with counsel; preserve briefs and court-stamped petition service.
Preserve request, appeal copy, interim status, security and ruling; an appeal alone is not the specified stay request.
Route alleged error to counsel with prejudice evidence; never label an operational control failure harmless using this hearing rule.
Retain authority references without creating a recurring safeguard.
Inspect ownership/control, covered functions and actual legal demands; shared corporate services alone do not create a hybrid designation.
Determine whether transaction functions invoke Part 162 and open a scoped dependency review if so; current inventory does not prove Part 162 coverage.
Retain dates as context and test that no new-service grace period is inferred.
Require dated pre-transition evidence and the exact exception before reliance; do not treat this as a new agreement exemption.
Retain initial dates as context and reconcile later changes separately.
Require the actual judgment/status analysis for the affected text; do not infer enforceability merely from its presence in XML.
